title: Irish crochet collar
excerpt: A delicate collar in lace weight yarn built from individual Irish crochet motifs joined into a curved neckline. Roses and leaves fill the background with a fine mesh net.
sourceNotes: A traditional Irish crochet collar constructed by making individual motifs and filling the spaces between them with a background mesh to form a curved band.

glossaryTerms.definition: A background of chain loops and slip stitches worked between the motifs of Irish crochet to hold the design together.
Connecting two Irish crochet motifs by working the final picots of one through a picot loop on the adjacent motif.

crochet.gaugeText: Each rose motif approx. 4 cm diameter. Collar measures approx. 42 cm along inner edge.
crochet.finishedSizeText: Collar band approx. 42 cm inner circumference x 8 cm deep.

Chain 6, join to ring. Work 5 raised petals as for the flower motif pattern. On the outer edge, instead of picots, chain 4 for connection points on adjacent motifs.
Work as for the Irish crochet leaf motif. Leave connecting chain loops at the base and tip.

Arrange 8 roses and 8 leaves in an arc roughly matching the neckline. Pin to a blocking board. Work mesh fill between all motifs using chain loops and slip stitches to connect each picot to its neighbours. Work the outer edge in a chain loop border. Sew snaps at the collar ends with the tapestry needle.
